b-cubed.slogan: The ultimate puzzle adventure! Play B-Cubed now.
b-cubed.description: Looking for a fun puzzle game? Solve challenging levels in B-Cubed, a captivating online game. Carefully maneuver the cube, passing over each square to win! Enjoy B-Cubed for free!

HomeIframe.title: B-Cubed
HomeIframe.description: Slide the cube using the arrows on your keyboard. Your goal is to pass over every single square on your way to the final square.

HomeFeatures.whatIsDescription: B-Cubed is a captivating puzzle game where you navigate a cube across a board, ensuring you touch every square to reach the end. It's a game of strategy and precision!
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep1: Use arrow keys to slide the B-Cubed.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep2: Pass over every square on the board.
HomeFeatures.howToPlayStep3: Reach the final square to complete the level.
HomeFeatures.feature1Description: Solve a variety of unique and challenging puzzles in B-Cubed.
HomeFeatures.feature2Description: Carefully plan your moves to succeed in B-Cubed.
HomeFeatures.feature3Description: Easy to learn, but hard to master B-Cubed controls.
HomeFeatures.feature4Description: Enjoy hours of engaging gameplay with B-Cubed.
